collection.description: The Hermetic Poimandres, the vision of the divine Mind and of the soul's ascent to become God, shown section by section on the oldest manuscript of the Corpus Hermeticum, with Parthey's Greek and G. R. S. Mead's English.

texts.title: Corpus Hermeticum I: Poimandres
texts.source: Florence, Biblioteca Medicea Laurenziana, Plut. 71.33 fol. 123r-125v (Biblioteca Medicea Laurenziana, Teca digitale (IIIF)) + Parthey's Greek (1854, Wikisource) + G. R. S. Mead's English (1906)
texts.description: The first Hermetic treatise: the vision of Poimandres, the divine Mind, on the making of the world, the fall of the archetypal Man and the soul's ascent through the seven spheres to God, shown complete on the 14th-century Florence manuscript Laur. Plut. 71.33.
